brief:
Israeli authorities released artist Odai Al-Zagha following 18 months in detention, Eye on Palestine reported. Al-Zagha, described as a captive artist, had been held in Israeli prisons since his arrest roughly a year and a half ago.

The release marks the end of an extended period of incarceration for the Palestinian artist. No immediate details emerged regarding the specific charges he faced, the conditions of his detention, or any terms associated with his release from Israeli custody.
